title: 16th Sitting of first Session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/16/1/2025).
From the Speaker's desk: the President's nominee for appointment as a Justice of the Supreme Court, under Article 148(a) of the Constitution, is sent to the relevant standing committee for review.

First reading of the resolution submitted by Hulhumalé South MP Dr Ahmed Shamheed to ascertain members' views on actions by the government and the Maldives Monetary Authority that go against the Constitution, related laws and the 2025 state budget passed by the Majlis.
Government Oversight Committee report on the President's request for Majlis approval of changes made to the mandates of three ministries under the powers given by Article 116(a) of the Constitution.
General Committee report on the proposal by Ihavandhoo MP Ahmed Naseer to amend the Majlis Standing Orders under Rule 272(c).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting sent a Supreme Court justice nominee to committee, gave first reading to a resolution on government and MMA actions against the 2025 budget, and took up reports on ministry mandate changes and Standing Orders amendments.
